messages.subject: Meridian Trade Park - due diligence enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

We've been through the data room. A first list of enquiries:

1. Please provide the asbestos management survey referred to in the index.
2. Confirmation of the rent deposit position for Unit 6 (Northgate Tooling) and a copy of the rent deposit deed.
3. The current service charge budget and the buildings insurance schedule.
4. Status of the Unit 9 rent review due 25 December.
5. Any outstanding tenant consents - we saw a reference to a mezzanine enquiry at Unit 7.

Formal CPSE replies would also be appreciated. Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

We'll upload the asbestos survey and insurance schedule today. The Unit 6 rent deposit is £84,000 - deed to follow. Northgate are a quarter in arrears; our client is chasing. The Unit 9 review hasn't been initiated. The Unit 7 mezzanine is an informal enquiry only, no application made.

CPSE.1 replies are in preparation and we'll circulate next week.

Amelia
